# Landing page pattern

## Reader job
Understand what this agent, skill, product, or resource is, why it may matter, and how to begin.

## Recommended order
1. Specific name and outcome-led headline.
2. One-sentence explanation in plain language.
3. Who it is for / when to use it.
4. What it helps the reader do (only verified capabilities).
5. One short example of how to start.
6. Primary next action and any important limitation.

## Useful components
- Editorial hero.
- Short "Use it when…" list.
- Two or three capability groupings.
- One real or clearly illustrative example.
- Compact limitations or prerequisites.

## Avoid
- Generic welcome language.
- Feature inventories without user outcomes.
- Unsupported promises.
- Multiple competing calls to action.
